title: The Beauty in Civility the Cost of Immorality

sense.text:
“Woe to the inhabiters of the earth and of the sea!” All of the nations. The devil over all the nations is going to bring hell on everybody, but mainly on the twelve tribes of Israel. The pendulum of change in this earth is on our clock. The change of worlds comes when we wake up. Everything in the heavens is waiting for the manifestation of the sons of God. That ain't everybody; that's you. There is a great, severe effort to make sure we never wake up. Messing with our women and getting them to turn against us is one of the tactics.

“for the devil is come down unto you, having great wrath”. The devil is the white man, Esau. But this ain't just about getting on the white man. The white man is only a tool in God's toolbox to put you into shape when you break his laws. He can only go as far as God allows him. We made our Father mad. God is our Father; we're his children. The rest of the nations are bastards. When we don't deal right, he takes these bastards and puts hell on us until we get some sense. It's our wicked behavior that summons an ass whooping.

We're in all the nations, but the most fire is coming down on us. Temptations are coming through TikTok, Facebook, everywhere. When you were in complete filth and debauchery, you were everybody's friend. The minute you try to get straight, here comes the damn devil through a negro, a family member, somebody on your job, or an old Facebook connection. Parents, cousins, even other brothers and sisters can influence your thoughts with evil and knock you off your course.

“because he knoweth that he hath but a short time.” He knows by watching you wake up. His effort is to make sure you don't wake up. Every time a wicked thought comes, ask yourself whether you're going to entertain that evil or walk away and stay on the path to the Lord's kingdom. Some have been losing faith and falling out. That's a small portion of us; the majority of the repented are going to make it. Sitting in the congregation smiling and giving greetings while you're wicked as hell won't save you. Get yourself right before it's too late.

Prepare for spiritual war right now. Men in the faith and power of God are going to set this planet back in order. Get your mind right, and Christ is coming with the angels to kill our enemies. You can't still be in crack, alcohol, drugs, fornication, lying, and cheating on each other, asking for the Lord's vengeance. You get your damn head chopped off asking for that. Make sure your mind is right first.

precepts.why:
“For, behold, the darkness shall cover the earth”. Darkness is sin, evil, debauchery, wickedness. Everybody's in sin, following Esau in his wickedness. All the foundations of the earth are out of course because we, as the gods, did not do what the Lord told us to do to keep the earth in its proper order. The congregation is us. We side with the wicked and don't judge uprightly. That finger is pointing at us men. We've been saps and suckers, allowing everything to go out of whack instead of standing up like men.

“and gross darkness the people”. Gross sin has fallen on the Israelites. We're in the greatest level of complete evil. That's the difference between the wrath on all the nations and the most fire coming down on us. Money will not solve the black man's problem. Give a negro billions of dollars and we would be uncontrollable in evil. Thank God we ain't got it. We're like wild weeds and fools; we would burn each other up and kill each other. We ain't got the sense to have that control right now.

“but the Lord shall arise upon thee, and his glory shall be seen upon thee.” That's when we get our minds right.

sense.text:
“I have commanded my sanctified ones”. God has given an order to the ones he cleaned up. The brothers and sisters are sanctified, but here it's particularly the men, because they have to do something with that sanctification. Get your minds and your spiritual houses in order, set your house in order, and go out and teach. Wake our people up and break the bands and bondage of following sin. Those are the warriors the Lord is looking for, men who fought against evil and sin and are ready to be his ambassadors.

“I have also called my mighty ones for mine anger”. The mighty ones are the angels, called to back you up with God's anger. “even them that rejoice in my highness.” The angels are with the Most High and Christ in the spirit world, sharpening those swords, ready to chop heads. Anger gets stuff done. When eight or nine heads get chopped off and you're the tenth one standing, you become an instant believer. That will straighten out the foolishness.

We ain't playing games with sin in here. We're trying to get to the kingdom and fix the ugliness in our nation. Bring foolishness in here and you will be thrown out. Nobody is going to deter us from that mission. If the leadership has to go on the streets by their damn self, God damn it, we'll do it.

“The noise of a multitude in the mountains”. The mountains are the governments. The Most High is causing arguments and tumult among the governments because you Israelites are waking up. Esau is putting hell on the nations, but the nations don't want you to wake up either. Everybody is watching us, watching these women, whatever they tell you about not knowing anything about the Israelites.

“like as of a great people”. A whole lot of nations are involved in keeping Israel down. They have gathered together with one consent so that the name of Israel is no more in remembrance. “a tumultuous noise of the kingdoms of nations gathered together”. These are the nations in darkness, and they want to make sure you stay in gross darkness. They've gathered against you.

“the Lord of hosts mustereth the host of the battle.” The Lord is the one instigating the fight. The Lord is a man of war. Their evil against his people gives him more reasons to chop them up.

“They come from a far country”. The missiles, the warfare the Most High is bringing. He's going to send terrorism here. “from the end of heaven”. From the other side of the earth. “even the Lord, and the weapons of his indignation”. God caused these nations to build weapons, and he's coming with those weapons. “to destroy the whole land.” This place is going to be obliterated. Nothing can stop that prophecy. Christ himself is going to bring it.

We are law-abiding. We've never done anything evil to anybody. We're reading the Bible. If you consider that offensive, the hell with you and your damn feelings.

precepts.why: “Sanctify them through thy truth: thy word is truth.” They've been cleansed by the word of God. That's how the sanctified ones got cleaned up. Now that you've got your minds and your spiritual houses in order, and you've set your house in order, go out and teach my people to wake up.

sense.text:
“Behold, the day of the Lord cometh, cruel both with wrath and fierce anger”. He's coming with fierce anger to get the job done. None of that nice Joel Olsteen, Pam soft waffles type of talk. He's coming with complete vengeance. That's what gets stuff done.

“to lay the land desolate: and he shall destroy the sinners thereof out of it.” Christ and the weapons are going to destroy the sinners out of it. You're the sinners, you Israelites who refuse to keep God's commandments. You keep playing with adultery, fornication, crack, alcoholism, lying, and all those evils. The day is coming when your ass will be destroyed by Christ and the angels. The ones of us who don't repent and keep playing in wickedness are the sinners who will be destroyed in Babylon the Great.

“And Babylon, the glory of kingdoms”. That's the whole land that's going to be destroyed. You sinning Israelites thought you were going to have your utopia here, in the sweet by and by with Esau and the rest of Satan's imps. You forgot about your God and your power and joined Satan.

“the beauty of the Chaldees’ excellency”. You just want to be part of Babylon, part of America. You hold this place in high esteem above the Bible, the laws of God, the commandments, and anything the Israelites say. You put your whole faith, body, and soul into Babylon and think you'll escape.

“shall be as when God overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah.” The ancient Babylon that Isaiah and the prophets lived in did not go down like that. They're talking about this filthy cesspool we're in right now. This Babylon is destined to be destroyed with fire and brimstone, the weapons God caused these smiths, these scientists, to build. Christ is coming with them to destroy the whole land. It's in the Bible; it's coming to pass regardless of how people feel about it.

precepts.why: “Then the Lord rained upon Sodom and upon Gomorrah”. How did God overthrow Sodom and Gomorrah? That's how he's going to do this Babylon. “brimstone and fire from the Lord out of heaven”. Fire is coming to burn up the whole land. Christ is going to make it happen. The ancient Babylon of the prophets' time didn't go down this way; this filthy cesspool we're in now is destined for that fire, those weapons Christ is coming with. Play games with this Bible and Christ will make an example out of you, a lesson so others don't be so damn stupid.

sense.text:
“Where there is no vision, the people perish”. As a father, a mother, or an individual, you need a goal of where you're trying to be in righteousness. Without a course, you'll be taken off course. If you don't know your own history, anybody's history will do. Without direction, you can be pulled in any direction. A father is supposed to give guidance and instruction, to be the goads that keep you from veering off. Brothers and sisters need a clear, distinct direction in righteousness or they'll fall off the mark.

If your instincts aren't clean and strong, you'll hesitate at the moment of truth. You'll falter when the temptation or trial comes because your direction isn't sharp and focused. People should be afraid to bring evil to you. They ought to see such a focus that bringing evil would be an assault on your intelligence. A sister shouldn't entertain a dude talking foolishness to get under her skirt, laughing like some damn hyena. Tell him not to come in your face with that disrespect again.

“but he that keepeth the law, happy is he.” The law is your mark. God's commandments are your direction. Anybody asking you to break them is Satan. Men and women both need that resolve. If somebody feels comfortable putting gossip and wickedness in your ear, check your own spirit. What did they see in you that made them think you would take that BS? Don't let somebody from ten or fifteen years ago get under your skirt over the phone.

We've had young children come through these doors, some without their parents, who are now captains and senior officers. They learned, got married, built families and careers, and escaped drugs, whoremongering, murder, and crime. Their parents came later and thanked us for saving them from destruction. That is happening in the schools across the globe. They got their minds right; our prayer is for them to stay right. We have to give them vision.

“The words of the wise are as goads”. The words from your leadership prick you into righteousness. A goad is a pointed rod used to urge on an animal. A shepherd prods the sheep with that stick so they don't veer off and get eaten by wolves. Something that urges or stimulates into action; something that pains as if by pricking, a thorn. Those scriptures prick your conscience and the sin in your mind to make you walk straight. To incite or rouse as if with a goad: we're to incite you into righteousness, rouse you up with the word of God.

We aren't up here to rub your back. A pastor rubbing your back and talking about accessing a portal is rubbing you right on to hell. The preacher is supposed to tell you to get yourself right. We're charged with leading you properly. Sometimes anger stimulates you into righteous action.

“and as nails fastened by the masters of assemblies”. That's Christ coming down through the leadership. We're organizing you, fastening you into a righteous assembly, putting you on the right path and teaching you how to avoid evil. “which are given from one shepherd.” That one shepherd is Christ. That's the shepherd's stick guiding you properly.

Leaders and parents are the goads for the next generation. If we don't provide a righteous path, the next generation will be fractured off and eventually our nation will perish. The Israelite movement is a fractured organization with an objective to destroy the children right under their parents' presence. When a man is establishing righteousness in his house, everybody needs to understand how serious that is. That ain't tearing up the house and breaking windows.

The mother needs to see the same danger the father sees. Think where these girls could end up if they aren't taught: nine babies, different diseases, no father, a wild bunch of jackasses coming from your daughter. Fight to make them understand because you're afraid for their lives. Righteously snatch their head off, spiritually. When mother and father move the same way, the child grows up right. If the child refuses both, the door is open. Get the hell out and live your life. Our prayer is that you don't go, but if you do, know for certainty you'll be judged.

Mother, father, sister, brother, daughter, son can't come before the commandments. Wicked children will want you to bend the laws for them. I'm not doing that. I did my best; I shake the dust. I'm not going to let my whole body burn trying to save my hand. Make your choice: follow the commandments or perish.

precepts.why:
“Remember them which have the rule over you”. That's the goads again. Remember them, respect them, pray for them. This is hard work, praying for mercy for all of us, including ourselves, and making sure we administer proper judgment. “who have spoken unto you the word of God”. Those are the wise words that prick you. “whose faith follow”. The faith we believe in is with us, and we're with that faith.

“considering the end of their conversation.” Listen for godly discourse, how to keep your lives right. That's the conversation we want the sisters having. The bishops put pressure on their wives to make sure the sisters are being taught righteousness and direction. Sometimes a sister does something nobody knew she would do, just as brothers sometimes do something out of the blue. That happens, but we still have to make sure the conversations are godly. The pressure is to do what God said, for their benefit.

Yes, we're strict, damn it. Think where these girls, seventeen, eighteen, nineteen, twenty, would be without it: diseases, babies, no husband, through by twenty-six, finished by twenty-nine, looking like a sea hag by thirty-five. We've got to fight to bring them up right. That's why God put them under the man, and they don't need weak-ass men. Be men and understand your purpose to rule this earth. The women get the benefit of that rulership when they get in order.

“Obey them that have the rule over you, and submit yourselves”. They're giving you the goads, the scriptures that prick you into righteousness. Appreciate it. Think about the near misses: Slick Willie could have got between your legs, knocked you up, walked away, and made you hoe number seventeen, another notch on his belt. You've escaped that. Whatever your past was, you're a new creature here. Get yourself together now.

That's why we work hard to set up Daughters of Sarah, Ladies in Waiting, Titus 2, all these programs. We're making proper sisters, daughters, wives, and mothers, that necessary part of building this nation. We aren't getting there without you. You're vital. If we're this serious about you, be serious about yourselves.

“for they watch for your souls, as they that must give account”. That's the heaviness on the leaders, the shepherds with these goads. When something goes wrong, we ask whether we went off or failed to handle something properly. We make a diligent inquiry right down to why you first thought of doing it, who was in the room, what time of day it was. Get to the root. Track the behavioral traits so when the next brother or sister begins that way, we can intercept before they destroy themselves. Without the cause, you won't solve the problem.

“that they may do it with joy, and not with grief”. We must give an account for every one of you, whether in righteousness or wickedness. We want to say you came with problems, learned the scriptures, went through the programs, got married, got children and a job and career, and got your family together. Trials still come, but we can give a good account of how the commandments cleaned you up. We don't want to say you didn't study, couldn't stop watching porn, smoking crack, or alcoholism, didn't listen, and aren't here anymore. That's grief.

“for that is unprofitable for you.” You suffer if we have to give that account with grief. You didn't adhere to the pricks. We have to let you go, cut off that hand or arm, and give the account that you didn't want to repent. We have to go through this to get to civility. Immorality costs us generations, our minds, the kingdom. Leadership is aging; we have to raise the next generation of brothers and sisters to carry this work on.

Radicalize the youth to be hot in this truth, not lukewarm, not letting BS pass. Make your fathers, grandfathers, and elders proud. We were entrusted with this gospel and won't let it turn into lasciviousness. With this Bible you know the past and the future and can travel through all ages. God gave that to Jacob. I ain't letting some worm mess it up. The hell with you and your mama.

Radius: a straight line from the center to the circumference of a circle or sphere. That circumference is how far the center point extends, not beyond. Radical is going beyond that circle in your thinking. When white people call you radical, you're thinking beyond the mold they set for you. It's a dog on a leash that can only go around inside that distance. Break the chain and run beyond their control, and you're radical. Don't beg Mr. white man to put the leash back on.

Look at the despair, our sons hating themselves and killing their own brothers and sisters, knocking women up without fatherhood and telling them to get abortions. Christianity is the leash keeping black men from thinking like men. You can go beyond Christian thought without criminal activity. Christ is black; pick up your pants, dress like a man, clean yourself up. The world says you don't have to. The hell with that, we're teaching you to be proper men. That's curbing crime, debauchery, homosexual lives, and fornication.

We're not telling anybody to pick up weapons or do anything criminal. Don't be a coward condemning the brothers trying to save your people just to appease the enemy and get us back on that leash. We're not doing that.

sense.text:
“Even the sea monsters draw out the breast, they give suck to their young ones”. Even sea monsters feed their little babies. “the daughter of my people is become cruel”. The Israelite women, the nation of Israel, is completely effed up. “like the ostriches in the wilderness.” Cruel like the ostrich, won't feed the babies. We throw our babies down garbage disposals and abort them. I haven't known a sea monster to abort its babies. Even the sea monsters have better sense.

That mother cat watching the hawk and owl had a circumspect eye for danger. She wanted her kitten to grow up. She moved the kitten out of the owl's way, got into a stance, and flew at the enemy. You will not kill my baby. That cat was radical. Anger made her defend her young. Where is that radicalness to stop what's happening to our children? Only our people have this dope needle of Christianity thinking in our brains, going into that dome of crack called a church. That cat wasn't turning the other cheek.

precepts.why:
“Gavest thou the goodly wings unto the peacocks?” God gave the beautiful peacock feathers. “or wings and feathers unto the ostrich?” He gave the ostrich her wings and feathers too.

“Which leaveth her eggs in the earth”. The silly ass woman leaves her eggs there. “and warmeth them in dust”. She sits on them to warm them so they'll hatch. “And forgetteth that the foot may crush them”. Then the same ostrich gets up and smashes the damn egg after warming it. That's the mentality the world wants our women in. Where's the radicalness to stop this? The sea monster must feed and take care of its babies. Animals have better damn sense than we do.

sense.text:
“And I looked, and there was none to help; and I wondered that there was none to uphold: therefore mine own arm brought salvation unto me”. This is Christ coming to put our enemies to death, coming to put Edom to death. Righteous anger gets ish done. The congregation needs to know how angry we are about sin; we're not smiling and playing games with it.

That ain't going upside somebody's head unjustly. If somebody comes to attack your family, I'm not going to tell you to pray for them. If I have the means to stop you hurting my family, your head is rolling down the street. I pray you don't come with the foolishness. If it be possible, I want to live in peace with all men.

“I have trodden the winepress alone”. Christ went into the white man's land. He came to America, not like Eddie Murphy. He's coming with chariots and strictly war on his mind, to judge and make war. The winepress is people's bodies. He's coming with his big black feet, putting them in a bowl and smashing them. Isaiah has a vision of what happens when Christ comes back.

“Who is this that cometh from Edom”. Isaiah sees Christ coming out after tearing Edom up. “with dyed garments from Bozrah?” Christ's garments are red with blood. Bozrah was the capital of Edom, letting you know this is the white folks. Idumea is the Greek word for Edom; it's the same time period.

“this that is glorious in his apparel, travelling in the greatness of his strength?” Isaiah sees him coming and asks who this is with blood all over his garments. It's question and response: Isaiah sees it, and Christ answers. “I that speak in righteousness, mighty to save.” It is I, Christ, that speaks in righteousness. I am mighty to save.

“Wherefore art thou red in thine apparel”. Christ, I see it's you coming out of Edom, but why are you red? “and thy garments like him that treadeth in the winefat?” Why do your garments look like you've been treading grapes?

“I have trodden the winepress alone”. Christ is explaining what he just did. The blood flowing so many furlongs in Revelation is the same time period. “and of the people there was none with me”. Nobody was with him when he was doing the smashing and killing.

“for I will tread them in mine anger”. Think of people coming to attack your family and a two-edged sword in your hand. Samson went through thousands with that jawbone. It took anger to get through those ribs, digging and pulling the guts out. You don't have time to worry where the blood flies; you're angry and want to complete the task. Christ is coming back with that kind of anger.

“and trample them in my fury”. In my fury I will smash skulls. “and their blood shall be sprinkled upon my garments”. Their blood will be all on his garments. “and I will stain all my raiment.” Blood all over his garments. That's war talk. Men talk like this.

“For the day of vengeance is in mine heart”. The vengeance is in Christ's mind. All I see is red. All I see is blood. All I see is vengeance. “and the year of my redeemed is come.” It's time to get redemption for my people.

“And I looked, and there was none to help; and I wondered that there was none to uphold”. There was none to uphold him. “therefore mine own arm brought salvation unto me”. His own arm brought forth the vengeance. “and my fury, it upheld me.” His fury upheld him.

After cutting up the enemies coming to hurt your family, you look back at all the heads and wonder what gave you the strength. Yes, the spirit of the Lord, but that spirit came with anger. The anger got you through it without crying over the little babies. Like that cat: move my baby out of the way, I'm ready for you now, damn it. Anger helped her get through it.

“Though all the nations that are under the king’s dominion obey him”. Everybody else could obey the king and fall away. “Yet will I and my sons and my brethren walk in the covenant of our fathers.” It took anger to defy what everybody else was doing, to have that resolve and resolute mind. You high-school boys and girls have all that nastiness around you, wicked people in your ear trying to get under your panties. Stand on that square. I don't give a damn, all of you can go to hell before I break these commandments. It takes anger to get there. Christianity tells you not to have it, and the minute they speak to you, your legs fly open like a damn V.

“God forbid that we should forsake the law and the ordinances.” We're not forsaking the law. “We will not hearken to the king’s words”. You're going against a whole government. That takes anger. Get angry enough not to falter when they come with swords, a gun, or try to break your spirit, like those seven sons went through. “to go from our religion, either on the right hand, or the left.” We ain't bending at all.

“there came one of the Jews in the sight of all to sacrifice on the altar which was at Modin, according to the king’s commandment.” Mattathias stood up against all that opposition, and here comes a negro right in front of him to sacrifice. People should be afraid to bring that foolishness before you. This one wasn't afraid at all, after everything Mattathias had said.

“he was inflamed with zeal”. Inflamed with anger and zeal. “and his reins trembled”. He was an older man too. “neither could he forbear to shew his anger”. He couldn't hide his anger. “according to judgment: wherefore he ran, and slew him upon the altar.” What gave him the strength? That anger. He ran, grabbed his ass, and killed his ass on the damn altar.

“Also the king’s commissioner, who compelled men to sacrifice”. Get the damn commissioner too, the one bringing them up and sending another and another to sacrifice. “he killed at that time”. It took that holy anger God puts on you when you've had enough. “and the altar he pulled down.” He pulled the altar down too.

“Thus dealt he zealously for the law of God”. His anger was a result of keeping God's commandments. Sisters, watch your sisters. When they talk craziness, put their ass on Front Street and get them out of here. Men, the same. They have a chance to repent and need to use the counsel we've set up. Don't let them sit in here and poison a precious sister or brother. Get hot when somebody tries to destroy our people.

“like as Phinees did unto Zambri the son of Salom.” Phineas saw the sin with the Moabite women sent by Balaam to tempt Israel into wickedness. They were having sex against God's law, and that was going to bring God's wrath on us. He had to kill them speedily in everybody's presence. The Lord was pleased: Phineas had his anger. He didn't destroy Israel because of that righteous anger for the nation.
“Whosoever is zealous of the law, and maintaineth the covenant”. Zealous for the law and the covenant of our fathers. “let him follow me.” Follow me; the rest of you go to hell. That's the attitude.

“So he and his sons fled into the mountains”. They left what they had in the city. Those seeking justice and judgment went into the wilderness. “Both they, and their children, and their wives; and their cattle”. Whole families had to get up and move. They're on the run. “because afflictions increased sore upon them.” The government came down hard on them, like it's going to do on us.

“Now when it was told the king’s servants, and the host that was at Jerusalem, in the city of David”. Our own people told on us, in a pact with the Greeks. Just like people now speaking against us trying to save our people and keep us in God's realm. That's why they didn't want this part of the Bible taught to you. “were gone down into the secret places in the wilderness”. They told where we were fleeing for succor.

“and made war against them on the sabbath day.” They studied us. Our own people were giving the enemy information about where we were and that we would not fight that day.

“come forth, and do according to the commandment of the king, and ye shall live.” Just come out and follow Satan and we'll let you live. How long do you think you'll live when Satan gives you a hand? You'll pay in the end, and our brothers knew it. “We will not come forth, neither will we do the king’s commandment, to profane the sabbath day.” They weren't coming out to break God's commandment.

“So then they gave them the battle with all speed.” They went full speed to kill us. “neither cast they a stone at them”. We didn't even throw a stone because it was the Sabbath. “nor stopped the places where they lay hid”. We didn't even close our doors.

“Let us die all in our innocency”. We would fight, but not on this day. We weren't afraid; we were trying to adhere to the Sabbath commandment. That's different from Christianity now, letting families and communities be destroyed because they love Esau. Christians will get their ass kicked all year by Esau, but they'll fight us for teaching the Bible. Guns at our heads, a brother's head attacked with a shoe, weapons brought against us. When it comes to the white man, it's peppermint candy and sweet Jesus. Christianity teaches you to love everybody but your own self, to hate anything that upsets massa. Where chattel slavery failed, Christianity perfected the slavery.

“heaven and earth will testify for us, that ye put us to death wrongfully.” Heaven and earth testify that you did us wrong while we kept God's law, and our God is going to judge you for it. Even there, we were praying for vengeance on our enemies. These Christians aren't thinking that way.

“they slew them, with their wives and children and their cattle, to the number of a thousand people.” They killed a thousand of our people that Sabbath because we adhered to the commandment. “they mourned for them right sore.” Mattathias and his friends mourned because those people were murdered.

“If we all do as our brethren have done, and fight not for our lives”. These white bastards don't have a conscience. They wouldn't give a damn about us all dying. At some point your anger needs to kick in and you need to start whipping ass. Stand up and fight. “and laws against the heathen, they will now quickly root us out of the earth.” They'll kill every last one of us.

We've got to stop sin in here. I ain't telling you to lay hands on anybody. Be that angry and fervent to keep evil out of every congregation. Be like the hawk, like that mother cat, circumspect with your eyes open. Listen to the sisters' conversations and get on their asses when it's wicked. The brothers too. I don't care if they get mad. That's not somebody misunderstanding a scripture. It's somebody looking to bring division and evil for Satan; we're going to be all on your behind.

“Whosoever shall come to make battle with us on the sabbath day, we will fight against him”. The brothers recognized that if they let them keep killing us on the Sabbath, they weren't going to change. We'd better stand up and fight, like that cat. “neither will we die all, as our brethren that were murdered in the secret places.” We ain't going for that anymore.

Stokely Carmichael, Kwame Ture, put it this way about Dr. Martin Luther King: Dr. King's major assumption was that if you're nonviolent and suffer, your opponent will see your suffering and be moved to change his heart. The fallacious assumption was that your opponent has a conscience. For nonviolence to work, he must have one. America has none. They can put you in slavery, say they've done nothing wrong, and eat steak over your dead body. Your suffering doesn't move their heart.

We were fighting against violence, not a violent people. They call you violent for fighting the violence and call you a hate group for fighting the hate projected at you. We were brought here slaves; they never paid for that, and then call us a hate group for speaking about the injustice.

Leave white folks alone. This isn't about putting hatred toward them. You and I need to concentrate on keeping God's commandments. When we do that, the Lord takes care of them. The rulers, the powers that be, aren't a terror to those doing the good works of the Bible. You ain't got to worry about him.

“So they joined their forces, and smote sinful men in their anger, and wicked men in their wrath”. That's what we've got to do in here, spiritually right now: get rid of wicked, sinful people. You can't let friendship stop you. We came in together, but you're in sin? Goodbye, and I'm telling on your black ass. You hear evil, tell it.

“but the rest fled to the heathen for succour.” They ran to the Greeks for safety because Mattathias and his sons were hunting them. You got a thousand of our people killed and want us to serve Satan? No. It's spiritual now, but it's going to become physical. Thank God when it becomes physical. It ain't there yet, but it's coming.

The anger we must put forth today is to get rid of sin among us. Even if you have to yell, we're not putting hands on anybody or looking for trouble in the streets.
